services.plain_role: Generates encryption keys in HashiCorp Vault used to construct encrypted values.

services.plain_role: Secure key management service providing encryption keys for Pseudonymise and Reconstruct jobs.

ibm_architectural_features.desc: Guaranteed Kubernetes resource requests across 7 pods equal 5.80 vCPU cores, fitting strictly within 6 physical cores with zero over-commitment.
Custom IBM OpenJ9 Generational Concurrent GC policy (-Xgcpolicy:gencon) and 75% container heap memory allocation (-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0) optimized for ppc64le hardware memory access patterns.
Pod requests match limits for critical microservices, preventing host noisy-neighbor throttling.

config.title: DataMasking Job
config.plain_concept: DataMasking converts sensitive text into irreversible hash values using cryptographic hashing algorithms. It secures data at rest and in transit.
config.safe_reason: 2,500 RPS verified on IBM Power (ppc64le) running RHEL 9.8 (Plow) with P95 latency at 45.30ms (well under SLA limit) and 0.0% error rate. 3,000 RPS peak ramp step achieved with P95 at 48.14ms; 60m soak verification pending.

config.title: Restrict Job
config.plain_concept: Restrict evaluates incoming requestor identities, roles, and contextual policies to dynamically grant or block data access.
config.safe_reason: 2,400 RPS verified safe on IBM Power (ppc64le) with P95 latency under SLA limit and 0.0% error rate.

config.title: Pseudonymise Job
config.plain_concept: Pseudonymise replaces sensitive identifiers with reversible tokens. Authorized users can later detokenize data.
config.safe_reason: 1,700 RPS verified safe on IBM Power (ppc64le) in 60m soak test with P95 latency under SLA limit and 0.0% error rate.

config.title: Reconstruct Job
config.plain_concept: Reconstruct validates policy permissions and detokenizes encrypted tokens back to plain text for authorized requestors.
config.safe_reason: 1,300 RPS verified safe on IBM Power (ppc64le) in 60m soak test with P95 latency at 14.41ms (well under 200ms SLA limit) and 0.0% error rate across 10.25 Million HTTP requests. 1,500 RPS peak ramp step achieved.
